items.title: Charlie Hardy Interview, 1961-12-16
items.q: Pierron was still playing, and Robichell was still playing, and they had King Oliver... We attended a lot of the musical extravaganzas he put on.

ctx.x: Uh, anybody, uh, you recall, upon your return, who impressed you in music, playing jazz around the world?

In New Orleans? Well, I took up where we left off. Uh, Pierron was still playing, and Robichell was still playing, and they had King Oliver, if you remember him. He was playing that, man. We attended a lot of the musical extravaganzas he put on. And then there was a band, I don't know what the name of it was, but there was a particular, uh, cornetist that had a pop eye. His right eye popped way out of his head and used to call him Monocle. And he had a band of five pieces. And they really did play music, that…
Oliver was, had a, uh, a bad eye, but not, uh, this. Um, now, on your return, you didn't hear any more dances at Tulane, did you? Or, or did you have occasion to go to Tulane?
